## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue`. Direction: nav editing closes on the transition to read-only. That keeps the surface's "unknown writability stays ungated" contract

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ⇒ `domain:ui`. It is the objectui#11124 / objectui#11136 class.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-30T02:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** It takes objectui#11124's and objectui#11136's grade (p2): an editor that accepts edits its autosave won't send, so an author's work is silently lost. It is reached only inside the in-flight window of the package-list request, which keeps it below p1.

**Direction.**
- **Close on the transition.** When `readOnly` becomes `true`, nav editing closes. `editNav` goes to `false` on the transition, so no canvas is left open that accepts edits its autosave will refuse.
- **Keep the toggle's contract.** ⛔ Don't withhold the toggle until the state settles. That would loosen PR objectui#11164's documented "unknown writability stays ungated" race pin. The card's own analysis prefers the transition, and so does triage.
- **One writer.** The deep link's apply (objectui#11153) and this transition both read `readOnly` through the same flag. ⛔ No second read-only mechanism.
- **Pins:**
  - Edit clicked while the list is in flight, then `writable: false`: nav editing closes, and no edit is left on screen unsaved;
  - `writable: true`: editing stays open (the control);
  - PR objectui#11164's race pin stays green.

**Serial.** It sits on PR objectui#11164's tri-state `pkgWritable` (objectui#11153, ACCEPTed and still open), so it is dispatched after that PR merges. The same file carries objectui#11158 (queued): whichever lands second rebases.

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| the change | one effect in `InterfacesPillar`, keyed on `readOnly`, `editNav` and `navDirty`. When `readOnly` holds, open nav editing closes the way the toggle closes it (`editNav` false, `navSel` null), and a dirty nav buffer is put back to the last loaded or saved document (`navBaselineRef`), with `navDirty` cleared. So no edit a read-only package refuses stays on screen. The toggle stays on offer while writability is unknown. The race-pin file of PR objectui#11164 is byte-unchanged and green |
| order | the effect is declared before `useNavSelDeepLink`, so a pending `?sel=nav:` link settled by the same answer keeps its read-only selection. Ablation leg 2 pins that order |
| tests | 5 pins: three read-only cases and two writable controls. Leg 1 (effect deleted) turns exactly the three read-only pins red. Leg 2 (effect after the deep link) turns exactly the pending-link pin red. `studio-design/`: 73 files, 414 tests |
| changeset | `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`; `Clause-②: no` |
| CI | head `7c7f285d5`: 43 runs, 40 success, 3 expected skips, 0 failure |
| size | 3 files, `InterfacesPillar` only |
| closing keywords | `Fixes #11167` only. The commit body line `Part of objectui#11167` is not a closing keyword |
| governed | none of the 3 paths is on objectui's governed surfaces |

**Deviations, answered.**
- **The buffer put-back diverges from the toggle,** which keeps a dirty buffer. It is right, and the card requires it: on a read-only package no autosave can reach the buffer, and keeping it would hold `navDirty` (the leave guard and the copilot refresh hold) for good.
- **The three-key effect:** right. It never clears a read-only deep-link selection.
- **The PR assignee is unset.** The dev's `label-write --assign` on PR objectui#11187 was refused by its session's permission layer. The seat does ⛔ **not** re-route a write a subagent's permission layer refused. It has been surfaced to the maintainer and is not a landing gate.

**Out of scope, one line each:**
- Two measured class-a sites in the nav autosave: (1) Done inside the debounce leaves the edit unsent; (2) an Add while a save is in flight is silently dropped. **filed objectui#11189** as the objectui#11124 / objectui#11136 family's nav closure card, one card for both sites, as the review judged.
- No notice is shown when an unsaved nav edit is put back on a read-only answer: **Acceptance notes**. It is a residual, not a defect, and a toast needs new strings in every locale pack.

**Next on this file:** objectui#11181 and objectui#11189 both edit `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`'s `InterfacesPillar`, so they run one after the other, after this PR lands.
